paper: Abdulatif Alabdulatif (2025), FedCognis: An Adaptive Federated Learning Framework for Secure Anomaly Detection in Industrial IoT-Enabled Cognitive Cities

queries: FedCognis github implementation code Abdulatif Alabdulatif trust aggregation
author_code_search.result: No public author implementation located in the article or targeted searches; similarly named FedCOG/FedCG repositories are different methods.

specification_notes.norm: Displayed Eqs.2/20 use L2 norm, prose following Eq.20 calls it squared Euclidean. Main uses displayed norm; squared version is retained as an interpretation sensitivity.
specification_notes.anchor: Algorithm1 local delta is local model minus starting broadcast; no additional stale global reference.
specification_notes.timing: Algorithm1 updates trust before aggregating. Eq15 model averaging supplies normalized trust-times-sample-count weights. Algorithm1 final formula is malformed and omits adding the broadcast to the weighted delta.
specification_notes.threshold: Prose mentions filtering and a figure uses update magnitude threshold .8, but Eq15/20 and Algorithm1 specify no reproducible hard trust cutoff. No new hard threshold is invented.
specification_notes.normalization: Stored trust follows Eq20 EMA, then normalized only for aggregation; Eq5 simplex constraint is not imposed recursively on the EMA ledger.
specification_notes.parameters: Table6 labels the trust penalty delta, while Eq20 uses beta; .5 is an explicit mapping choice, not a complete author default. Alpha and initial trust are not specified numerically; choose .5 and1. Report beta .1 and .7 sensitivities.
specification_notes.authentication: Model-poisoning clients are participating identities. Their signatures could be valid; do not use simulator attacker labels as signature failure. QSA cryptography and its claimed overhead/benefits are outside this aggregation comparison.
specification_notes.recovery: Use symmetric EMA from Eq20. The reported .024-per-round recovery is not a separate specified update rule and is not invented as one.
specification_notes.scope: Reuse existing MNIST CNN/SGD workload. No SALSTM/time-series/QSA/communication-sparsification reproduction, external reference data or calibration.
specification_notes.prose_direction: The sentence after Eq20 is unclear about whether drift avoids a penalty; the negative exponential itself monotonically penalizes distance. We implement the equation without an intent-dependent exception.
